'''Tol Amn''' was a murky, stormy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Tol Amn system/Legends|of the same name]], in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Oktos Route]] that connected it both to the planet [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] and the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]].<ref name="TEA" />

Tol Amn was used by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] [[Agriworld/Legends|production]], with serfs of various species being employed to that end.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[hyperwave signal interceptor]]s at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Oktos Zone Imperial Outpost]] on Toydaria could monitor [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] activity at Tol Amn.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tol Amn was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square R-11.<ref name="TEA" />
